#lang beagle/js
(ns wake.fixtures.neutral-release
  (:require [wake.core :as wake]))

(wake/command-receipt-core)

(wake/defentity-ref release "release" "release")

(wake/define-entity-model
  release
  Release
  "release"
  [[id "release/id" "id" String
    (wake/->StringField nil)
    (wake/->SingleField nil)
    (wake/->IdentityWrite nil)
    "wake-neutral-release/field/release/id"
    true]
   [state "release/state" "state" String
    (wake/->StringField nil)
    (wake/->SingleField nil)
    (wake/->SetWrite nil)
    "wake-neutral-release/field/release/state"
    true]]
  []
  "wake-neutral-release/entity/release")

(wake/defcomponent-model
  release-card
  "release-card"
  [(wake/->ComponentPropertySpec :id (wake/->StringValueType nil nil nil))
   (wake/->ComponentPropertySpec :state (wake/->StringValueType nil nil nil))]
  [(wake/->Element
     :div
     {:class (wake/->StaticAttr "release-card")}
     [(wake/->Element :span {:text (wake/->BindAttr :id)} [])
      (wake/->Element :span {:text (wake/->BindAttr :state)} [])])])

(wake/defview-model
  release-detail
  "release-detail"
  "release-detail"
  release-ref
  release-card-ref
  "Releases"
  nil
  nil)

(wake/defstring-role channel "channel" 1 nil nil)

(wake/defplugin-configuration
  plugin-configuration
  []
  [channel]
  [] [] [] [] [] [] [] [])

(wake/defplugin-exports
  plugin-exports
  [release-ref]
  [release-id-ref release-state-ref]
  [] [] [] [] [] [] [] []
  [release-card-ref]
  [release-detail-ref]
  [] [] [] [])

(wake/defplugin
  neutral-release-plugin
  "wake-neutral-release"
  "0.1.0"
  "0.1.0"
  1
  1
  [(wake/->SchemaContribution nil)
   (wake/->UiContribution nil)]
  plugin-configuration
  plugin-exports
  []
  []
  nil)
